months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달이다(2024년 12월~2025년 3월 김포에서 겨울을 난 한 개체).

summary: 2024년 12월 22일 경기도 김포 하성면의 습지 부근에서 처음 발견되어 2025년 3월 초까지 머문 첫해 어린새 한 마리가 국내 유일한 기록인 길잃은새이다. 중앙아시아와 이란·아프가니스탄의 메마른 덤불 지대에서 번식하고, 겨울에는 서남아시아와 아라비아반도, 아프리카 동북부로 내려간다. 가시덤불 꼭대기에 앉아 있다가 메뚜기 같은 곤충을 덮쳐 잡는다.

points.en: white supercilium above a black mask (male)
dull grey-brown mantle, duller than the rufous crown
white patch at the base of the primaries (male)
fine dark vermiculation on the breast (female, first winter)

sexes.male: 몸 윗면이 짙은 갈색이고 정수리가 적갈색이며, 흰 눈썹선과 검은 눈선이 뚜렷하고 허리와 꼬리는 짙은 적갈색이다. 아랫면은 거의 희고 날개에 작은 흰 점이 있다.
sexes.female: 수컷과 비슷하나 색이 흐리고 대비가 약하며, 눈선이 갈색이고 눈썹선이 덜 뚜렷하다. 가슴 옆과 옆구리에 희미한 비늘무늬가 있다.

young: 어린새와 첫 겨울새는 옆구리와 허리·위꼬리덮깃에 가는 물결무늬가 있고, 남아 있는 어린 날개덮깃에 작고 어두운 무늬가, 꼬리 끝 가까이에 작은 검은 무늬가 있다. 정수리가 등보다 따뜻한 색이고 허리가 적갈색이다.

similar.how: 덤불때까치는 몸 윗면이 옅은 모래빛 회갈색으로 고르고 아랫면이 크림빛 담황색이지만, 붉은꼬리때까치는 윗면이 더 짙은 갈색에 정수리가 적갈색이고 흰 눈썹선이 뚜렷하며 아랫면이 더 희다.

art.subject: Red-tailed Shrike (Lanius phoenicuroides), female-type bird (first-winter or adult female) in winter, as the bird that wintered in Korean farmland in January and February: crown and nape warm rufous-brown, brightest on the forehead; mantle, back and scapulars plain grey-brown; a narrow whitish supercilium above a dark brown mask from the eye to the ear-coverts, the lores paler; throat and cheeks white; breast and flanks creamy buff with fine dark crescent-shaped scaling on the breast sides and flanks; belly whitish; wings dark brown with pale buff fringes to the coverts and tertials; rump, uppertail coverts and tail bright rufous; bill dark grey and hooked, with a paler base to the lower mandible; iris dark; legs dark grey.
art.pose: perched upright on a bare shrub top, side view, scanning the ground below
art.scene: Korean farmland edge in mid-winter, dry grass, reed stems and bare shrubs in clear daylight; no people, buildings or text
views: first-winter or adult female in winter, side view perched upright on a bare shrub top: rufous-brown crown, pale supercilium, narrower blackish-brown mask, white throat, dull grey-brown mantle, whitish underparts with fine dark vermiculation on the breast and flanks, rufous-red uppertail coverts and tail, hooked bill

adult male, side view perched upright on a bush top: rufous-brown crown, clear white supercilium, black mask, white throat, dull grey-brown mantle, white patch at the base of the primaries, mainly whitish underparts, rufous-red uppertail coverts and tail, hooked bill
art.build: A medium-sized shrike, about the size of a Brown Shrike: clearly longer than a sparrow, with a large head, thick neck and long tail. Bill strong, dark grey, shorter than the head, the upper mandible ending in a small hook. Legs fairly short, dark grey, with strong feet. Wings rather short; at rest the wingtips reach only just past the base of the tail. Tail long, narrow and rounded at the tip. Perches upright and conspicuously on bush tops, wires and posts, dropping to the ground for insects; flight low and undulating, swooping up to a new perch.
avoid: Do not paint a uniformly rufous-brown back and tail; that is Brown Shrike (Lanius cristatus). Here a grey-brown mantle contrasts with the rufous crown and bright rufous tail.
Do not paint the crown the same sandy grey as the back; that is Isabelline Shrike (Lanius isabellinus).
Do not give it a grey crown and back with black-and-white wings and tail, as in the grey shrikes.
Do not paint the adult male's jet-black mask and clean white underparts; this winter bird has a dark brown mask and fine dark crescents on the creamy breast sides and flanks.
